definition: Equipment, design or operational changes explicitly intended or required to reduce energy use for the same or improved service. Includes efficient equipment and cooling, network technology changes, energy management and defined energy-performance requirements. An explicit efficiency function is required; newer technology, lower costs or emissions claims alone are insufficient. Renewable electricity is renewable_energy. Includes laws, regulations, standards and plans specifically about energy efficiency, including sector-wide efficiency rules.
boundary: Not renewable electricity, which is renewable_energy; not newer technology, lower costs or emissions claims without an explicit efficiency function.
